secrets.name: GOOGLE_SHEET_ID
secrets.description: Spreadsheet ID from the sheet URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<ID>/edit) where burst history is appended.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
secrets.description: Google service account key JSON (Google Cloud > IAM > Service accounts > Keys > Add key > JSON), either raw or base64-encoded. The Sheets API must be enabled and the sheet shared with the key's client_email as Editor.
